dataset.name: LNMO-NMP-2 cell fa5db1 GITT half-cell OCV (BDF)
dataset.description: Known issue: Anomalously high voltage measurements during the pulse step. Half-cell OCV electrochemical time series for LNMO-NMP-2 coin cell fa5db1, measured with the GITT protocol at room temperature. Apache Parquet in Battery Data Format (BDF). File sintef__sintef-lnmo-R2032-intelligent2-fa5db1__20250424__gitt__RT.bdf.parquet of Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.20086298.

notes: Known issue reported by the source for this measurement: Anomalously high voltage measurements during the pulse step. The test record that produced this file states it as a conformance deviation (status non-conformant, category out_of_tolerance); it is repeated here so the warning travels with the data rather than only with the test.
